name: OTel Mule 4 Agent - JVM Enhancement Metrics (v1.6.0)
description: CPU, GC, and Thread metrics added in v1.6.0 of the OTel Mule 4 Observability Agent

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(process.cpu.utilization) * 100 AS 'CPU %' FACET service.name SINCE 5 minutes ago

FROM Metric SELECT filter(latest(jvm.thread.count), WHERE jvm.thread.daemon = true) + filter(latest(jvm.thread.count), WHERE jvm.thread.daemon = false) AS 'Total Threads' FACET service.name SINCE 5 minutes ago

rawConfiguration.text:
# JVM Metrics (v1.6.0)

Added to diagnose CPU spikes:

- `process.cpu.utilization` - CPU % (symptom)
- `jvm.gc.collection_time` - GC time (cause #1)
- `jvm.thread.count` - Thread count (cause #2)

**Alert thresholds:**
- CPU > 80% for 5 min
- GC time spike
- Thread count trending up over days = leak

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(process.cpu.utilization) * 100 AS 'CPU %' FACET service.name SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT filter(latest(jvm.thread.count), WHERE jvm.thread.daemon = true) + filter(latest(jvm.thread.count), WHERE jvm.thread.daemon = false) AS 'Total Threads' FACET service.name SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT latest(jvm.thread.count) FACET service.name, jvm.thread.daemon SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

widgets.title: GC Collection Time by Collector (ms, cumulative)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(jvm.gc.collection_time) AS 'GC Time (ms)' FACET service.name, jvm.gc.name SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT latest(process.cpu.utilization) * 100 AS 'CPU %', filter(latest(jvm.thread.count), WHERE jvm.thread.daemon = true) + filter(latest(jvm.thread.count), WHERE jvm.thread.daemon = false) AS 'Threads', max(jvm.gc.collection_time) AS 'Max GC Time (ms)' FACET service.name SINCE 10 minutes ago
